connector.name: Attest MCP by SPAZIO-GENESI
connector.registryDescription: Free proof-of-existence attestation for digital files, MCP tools for the imgauth service.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package attest-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the spazio-genesi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IMGAUTH_API_KEY
env.description: API key credential for the attestation service (optional — bypasses the interactive device-flow authorization).

env.name: IMGAUTH_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL, e.g. for local development against a `wrangler dev` instance.

env.name: IMGAUTH_CERT_PAGE_BASE
env.description: Override the base URL used to build permanent certificate-verification page links.
